title: Foundry First 30 Minutes Preview
steps: Open the Foundry Terminal dashboard and confirm the internal-preview badge.
Read What Now and complete Foundry Orientation with one Lens scan.
Restore the first PowerGrid spine and scan the starter battery.
Use HoloMap next-objective markers if HoloMap is installed; otherwise continue through MissionCore and Index.
Mark and scan the first processor worksite.
Read depot request guidance, check the first meter, and review known issues before judging preview readiness.
whatNow: Terminal should always name the next action before asking the player to inspect a secondary panel.
